findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "ask" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: before_checkout, find_stores, why_blocked_and_fix, report_outcome, store_record, compare, precheck, precheck_bulk, can_agent_checkout, ask_arc, google_checkout_readiness, dataset_info, submit_leaderboard_run, submit_store, validate_ucp_profile, get_benchmark, generate_fixes · Private data: why_blocked_and_fix, report_outcome, store_record, generate_fixes · Public sink: report_outcome, precheck_bulk, submit_leaderboard_run, submit_store · Destructive: submit_leaderboard_run, get_benchmark.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: before_checkout, find_stores, why_blocked_and_fix, report_outcome, store_record, compare, precheck, precheck_bulk, can_agent_checkout, ask_arc, google_checkout_readiness, dataset_info, submit_leaderboard_run, submit_store, validate_ucp_profile, get_benchmark, generate_fixes · Private data: why_blocked_and_fix, report_outcome, store_record, generate_fixes · Public sink: report_outcome, precheck_bulk, submit_leaderboard_run, submit_store · Destructive: submit_leaderboard_run, get_benchmark

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
